description: This file defines the SugarFieldDatetimecombo class, a custom field for handling date and time inputs within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for rendering edit, search, and import views, as well as saving and sanitizing date-time data.

classes.name: SugarFieldDatetimecombo
classes.description: A custom field class extending SugarFieldBase to manage date-time input, display, and import in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getEditViewSmarty
methods.description: Generates Smarty variables for rendering an edit view widget for date and time.

methods.name: getImportViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares Smarty variables for importing date-time data.

methods.name: getSearchViewSmarty
methods.description: Creates Smarty variables for rendering search view widgets, including range search functionality.

methods.name: getEmailTemplateValue
methods.description: Returns a formatted date-time string suitable for email templates.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the date-time value from parameters into the bean, converting formats as needed.

methods.name: importSanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes and validates imported date-time values, converting them to database format.
